methods.name: Early quests
methods.note: Goblin generals subquest and Fairytale I reach 20, The Garden of Death reaches 30. The full list gives 32,500 XP, level 38.

methods.name: Herb runs
methods.note: Falador, Catherby, Ardougne and Hosidius patches with ultracompost and magic secateurs. Morytania, Varlamore, Trollheim, Weiss and Harmony Island add one each.

methods.name: Tree runs
methods.note: Lumbridge, Varrock, Falador, Taverley and the Gnome Stronghold. Pay each gardener to protect and to clear. Oak grows in 2 h 40 min, magic in 8 hours.

methods.name: Fruit tree runs
methods.note: Gnome Stronghold, Tree Gnome Village, Catherby and Brimhaven. Every fruit tree takes 16 hours. Palm trees cost far less an XP than dragonfruit.

methods.name: Varlamore tree patches
methods.note: The Nemus Retreat tree patch and Kastori fruit tree patch, then Kastori's calquat from 72, done on your usual runs. Varlamore opens after Children of the Sun.

methods.name: Lletya fruit tree patch
methods.note: Lletya opens once Mourning's End Part I is started, which is enough. A teleport crystal takes you straight to the patch.

methods.name: Coral nurseries
methods.note: Two underwater nurseries off The Great Conch: elkhorn at 28, pillar at 52, umbral at 77. Compost does nothing, so pay the gardener. Frags are bought or looted.

methods.name: Tithe Farm
methods.note: Hosidius minigame that needs no seeds of your own. Unlocks the farmer's outfit, seed box, herb sack and auto-weed.

methods.name: Hardwood tree runs
methods.note: Three patches on Fossil Island. Teak takes 74 h 40 min, mahogany, camphor and ironwood 85 h 20 min, rosewood 96 hours. Pay the gardener to protect them.

methods.name: Locus Oasis hardwood patch
methods.req: q:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute
methods.note: One more hardwood patch, in Locus Oasis in Varlamore, after The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute. Fairy ring AJP lands close by.

methods.name: Anglers' Retreat hardwood patch
methods.note: Needs 51 Sailing to moor. Building the rowboat from Corsair Cove (50 Construction, 8 camphor planks, 10 swamp paste) makes the trip much quicker.

methods.name: Hespori
methods.note: Farming Guild boss patch. Plant a Hespori seed and kill it 32 hours later for 12,600 XP. Checking trees on daily runs turns up a seed every day or two.

methods.name: Farming Guild patches
methods.note: The guild's tree and herb patches from 65 and its fruit tree patch from 85, done on your usual runs. Celastrus, redwood and Hespori are listed on their own.

methods.name: Calquat trees
methods.note: Tai Bwo Wannai patch, done with the fruit trees. Payment is 8 poison ivy berries. Grows in 21 h 20 min. Kastori and The Summer Shore are listed on their own.

methods.name: Summer Shore calquat patch
methods.note: Getting to The Summer Shore needs Troubled Tortugans partly done, which is enough. Fairy ring CJQ then 50 Agility, or a charter ship.

methods.name: Crystal tree
methods.note: Prifddinas patch that cannot die. Grows in 8 hours and gives about 30 crystal shards with ultracompost. Each acorn costs a crystal weapon seed.

methods.name: Celastrus tree
methods.note: Farming Guild patch at 85, grows in 13 h 20 min. Chop the bark, about 9 with ultracompost, worth far more than the sapling. Payment is 8 potato cacti.

methods.name: Redwood tree
methods.note: Farming Guild patch. Takes 106 h 40 min to grow and 2,000 coins to clear. Payment is 6 dragonfruit, so about a coin an XP.

unverified: Early quests: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0); the training guide's seven quests total 32,500 XP (level 38) and the ironman guide's six, without My Arm's Big Adventure, 27,500 (level 37); no page rates bagged plants, compost, allotments or Sorceress's Garden by the hour, so levels 1 to 8 stay unrated

Run rates are XP an hour of time spent on the run and rest on one timing, the training guide's 14 patches in about 5 minutes 20 seconds (22.9 seconds a patch); Wise Old Man's all-runs rates imply 22.5 to 27 seconds a patch, within 17%; herb patches are taken at 45 seconds, the middle of the runs page's five to ten minutes for ten (the money making guides say 6 minutes)
Hardwood tree runs, Locus Oasis and Anglers' Retreat: no page times a hardwood run, so the tree run's pace is used; XP a run is exact

Hardwood entries: every is 5,120 minutes, right for mahogany, camphor and ironwood (55 to 91, most of the XP); teak at 35 to 54 really comes round in 4,480, so its XP a day is counted 12.5% low, and rosewood from 92 in 5,760, so 12.5% high; rosewood is 5,760 minutes (its own page and RuneLite: 9 growth ticks of 640), not the 6,400 of the seed table and training guide

Herb runs: XP a patch is planting + 36 for ultracompost + harvest XP x the expected yield with magic secateurs from each herb's chance-to-save constants (6.9 herbs for guam at 9, 9.1 for torstol at 85); huasca's page gives no constants, 58 is assumed between snapdragon and cadantine; the money making guides' measured 8.8 at 99 is 4% under the formula's 9.2 because some patches die

Herb runs count the four patches open to everyone; Morytania (Priest in Peril), Varlamore (Children of the Sun), Trollheim (My Arm's Big Adventure), Weiss (Making Friends with My Arm) and Harmony Island (elite Morytania diary) add one patch each and are not counted; the Farming Guild patch is in Farming Guild patches

Tree runs: oak grows in 160 minutes (seed table, oak's own page, RuneLite), not the training guide's 200; XP is planting + check-health with the gardener paid, so no compost XP; Nemus Retreat (Children of the Sun) and the Farming Guild (65) are separate entries
Fruit tree runs: XP includes picking the 6 fruit (the seed table's totals); dragonfruit's 17,895 is the seed table's sum (140 + 17,335 + 420), the training guide's 17,825 is a slip

Farming Guild patches and Varlamore tree patches gain patches at higher levels, and the app scales XP a run by the hourly rate, so their rates are worked out over the time of the whole run: XP a run is exact at every level and the hourly rate is low until the last patch opens (85 and 72)
Lletya fruit tree patch: Mourning's End Part I only has to be started, which req cannot say, so it asks for the whole quest and is stricter than the game
Summer Shore calquat patch: Troubled Tortugans only has to be partly done to reach The Summer Shore, which req cannot say; the coral nurseries do need it finished (Coral nursery (patch))

Coral nurseries: yield from the frag pages' constants (6 lives since 19 August 2026, no compost, magic secateurs), which reproduce the 4 June 2026 blog's averages exactly (elkhorn 19.44 at 77 and 27.93 at 99, pillar 16.17 and 26.95, umbral 13.24 and 25.60); each band uses the yield at its first level; the rate uses the money making guide's 2.25 minutes a run, one source

Hespori: no page gives a kill time, so no hourly rate (xph 0); per is 62 planting + 12,600 on the kill; seeds are untradeable and come at 500 times the Tangleroot base chance from checking trees: about 0.6 a day at 65 from the patches open to everyone (0.7 with Varlamore's, about 0.8 by 85), against the 0.75 a kill every 32 hours needs, so Hespori is counted up to a quarter high below 75
Celastrus tree: 204 planting (seed table and training guide; its own page says 200) + 14,130 + 36 ultracompost + 8.8 bark at 23.5 (money making guide; the guide's footnote says about 9)

Tithe Farm: 95,000 is the middle of the guide's 90,000 to 100,000 from 74, and 85% of the strategy page's 'up to 115,000' for the 25x4 method is 97,750; its combo table gives 108,380, and the Farmer's outfit page's 76 points an hour for a reasonably efficient player is 80,400; 34 and 54 scale by XP per 100 fruit (9,660, 22,540, 37,030); the ironman efficiency table's 66,000 at 54 is above the 57,800 band

Costs at Grand Exchange prices of 14 October 2026 10:31 UTC, with sapling, payment and clearing fee: magic trees 7.3 coins an XP, dragonfruit 9.0 net of the fruit picked (palm 3.3), rosewood 8.4 and teak 0.5, redwood 1.0, calquat 0.2, crystal 22 through a crystal weapon seed; celastrus bark, coral and herbs sell for more than they cost; pricey is above 9.1 coins an XP, midway between the Construction file's oak larders (cheap, 8.8) and teak benches (pricey, 9.4), so only the crystal tree is pricey

Hours: the app counts Farming hours at the single fastest run (hardwood or redwood, up to 3.7 million an hour of run time), where Wise Old Man's rate for doing every run is 304,000 at 38 rising to 2.5 million from 90; the days figure Farming shows is not affected

Not included: spirit trees (19,500 XP a tree from 83, up to four trees before 99 since 4 February 2026, but the seeds are untradeable and rare); allotment runs (the training guide's add-on to herb runs, about 17,500 XP a run of snape grass at 61 over the eight open allotments, left out so the days figure counts the runs both guides train with); giant seaweed (the ironman guide's Crafting supply, about 800 XP a run at 23, already a timed reset); farming contracts (the XP is the crops grown); bushes, hops, cacti, belladonna, mushrooms and the vinery (no guide trains with them); bagged plants and Sorceress's Garden (no hourly rate)
